Hand.title: Ace of Cards — Hand
Hand.noDeck: This character has no deck yet. The GM can create it.
Hand.empty: Your hand is empty. It is dealt when a conflict starts.
Hand.noSet: These cards form no set: resolving only cycles them.
Hand.pick: Click cards in the order you want to discard them.
Hand.noSetConfirm: Discard these cards and draw the same number without any effect?

GM.title: Ace of Cards — GM panel
GM.none: No character with the Magic Cards skill.
GM.presetChanged: Deck of {name} rebuilt with the new art.

Part.freeAttack: Free attack with an equipped weapon; its damage becomes {type}.
Part.duelMaster: Duel Master: +{dmg} damage with arcane, dagger, firearm, sword or thrown weapons.
Part.highOrLow: High or Low until your next turn: +{dmg} damage dealt, −{red} damage taken
Part.forbiddenRite: Forbidden Rite: {count} card(s) shuffled from the discard pile into the deck

jackpot.name: Jackpot
jackpot.text: Surrendered PCs present regain consciousness; you and every ally you can see recover 777 HP and 777 MP.

forbiddenMonarch.name: Forbidden Monarch
forbiddenMonarch.text: 777 damage to every enemy you can see (light if even, dark if odd).

magicFlush.name: Magic Flush
magicFlush.text: 25 + total value damage to every enemy you can see, of the suit's type.

blindingFlush.name: Blinding Flush
blindingFlush.text: 15 + total value damage to every enemy you can see; light if the highest card is even, dark if odd.

fullStatus.name: Full Status
fullStatus.text: Choose two of dazed, shaken, slow, weak: even highest card heals the group, odd inflicts them on enemies.

tripleSupport.name: Triple Support
tripleSupport.text: You and every ally you can see recover HP equal to the total value × 3.

doubleTrouble.name: Double Trouble
doubleTrouble.text: 10 + highest value damage to up to two enemies (target them first).

magicPair.name: Magic Pair
magicPair.text: Free attack with an equipped weapon; damage becomes a suit's type.

Error.noSkill: This character does not have Magic Cards.
Error.cardCount: Magic Cards resolves {min} to {max} cards at your Skill Level.
Error.trapSuit: Only jokers and {suit} cards can be discarded for this action.
Error.trapUsed: Trap Card was already used; it is available again at the start of your next turn.

Notify.noAce: You have no Ace of Cards character.

Keybinding.openPanel: Open Ace of Cards GM panel

damageMode.name: Damage to enemies
damageMode.hint: Whether set damage waits for GM approval in chat.

recoveryMode.name: HP/MP recovery
recoveryMode.hint: Whether healing waits for GM approval.

statusMode.name: Status effects and temporary bonuses
statusMode.hint: Whether status changes wait for GM approval.

mpMode.name: Magic Cards MP cost
mpMode.hint: Charge MP immediately or include it in the proposal.

approvers.name: Who approves
approvers.hint: Users allowed to approve, reject and revert proposals.

reactionHints.name: Reaction hints
reactionHints.hint: Notify the player when Trap Card or Mulligan can be used.

autoSetupConflict.name: Automatic conflict setup
autoSetupConflict.hint: Shuffle and draw 5 when combat starts; recall all cards when it ends.

Swap.heading: Other card Skills
Swap.mulliganHint: After you hit with an attack on your turn: discard up to {max} cards and draw that many.
Swap.trapHint: After an enemy you can see resolves an action: discard up to {max} matching cards or jokers, draw that many, then cast a spell for free.
Swap.trapSpell: Trap Card (enemy {action}): you may now perform the Spell action for free, casting spells with a total MP cost of up to {mp} (you still pay the MP).

Rite.title: Forbidden Rite
Rite.text: You discarded a joker. Choose any non-joker cards in your discard pile to shuffle into your deck.

SetHand.title: Draw specific hand
SetHand.text: Testing tool: tick the cards that should be in the hand. Unticked hand cards go back into the deck; ticked cards are taken from the deck, discard pile or vanguard. The deck is reshuffled.
